posts.text: The most inflationary component of the PPI was... the stock market. Leading the July increase in PPI services was the index for portfolio management which soared 6.5% MOM, reflecting equity price gains
posts.author: zerohedge

posts.text: JUST IN: 🇺🇸 US PPI falls to 4.7%, lower than expectations.
posts.author: WatcherGuru

posts.text: BREAKING: July PPI Inflation falls to 4.7%, below expectations of 4.9%. Core PPI Inflation fell to 4.2%, in-line with expectations of 4.2%. Month-over-month PPI inflation was flat, at 0.0%, the first such reading since June 2025. The odds of rate hikes are declining further.
posts.author: KobeissiLetter
